data.name: Between Jobs : Fixer Sim
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Between Jobs: Fixer Sim is a first-person repair and business simulation game where every broken item is an opportunity to earn money, grow your reputation, and build a successful repair business.

After losing your job, you decide to start over with a small repair workshop. Take on repair requests from customers, diagnose problems, replace damaged parts, negotiate payments, and manage your finances while working your way from a struggling freelancer to a trusted neighbourhood fixer.

Every completed job helps you unlock better tools, bigger contracts, and new opportunities. As your business grows, so do the challenges. Upgrade your workspace, improve your skills, purchase equipment, and make smart financial decisions to keep your business running.

Explore a living town, interact with unique customers, discover side activities, and balance your income and expenses while building your career from the ground up.

Whether you're repairing household electronics, solving customer problems, or expanding your workshop, every decision shapes your journey toward becoming the town's most reliable fixer.

Key Features

🔧 Repair & Restore

Diagnose faults, replace damaged components, repair everyday devices, and complete satisfying repair jobs using realistic tools and mechanics.

💼 Build Your Repair Business

Accept contracts, earn money, improve your reputation, unlock better-paying jobs, and grow from a small workshop into a successful repair business.

🌍 Explore an Open World

Travel around town, meet new customers, discover opportunities, and experience a dynamic environment filled with interactive locations.

📈 Manage Your Finances

Pay bills, purchase tools, invest in upgrades, and make strategic decisions to keep your business profitable.

🛠 Upgrade Your Workshop

Unlock advanced equipment, organize your workspace, and improve efficiency as your business expands.

🤝 Meet Unique Customers

Every customer has different repair requests, personalities, and stories, creating varied and engaging gameplay.

🎮 Relaxing Yet Rewarding Gameplay

Enjoy a satisfying progression system that combines repair mechanics, business management, exploration, and career growth.

Start From Nothing. Build Everything.

Your job may be gone, but your future is in your hands.

Fix. Earn. Upgrade. Repeat.

Can you turn a small repair shop into the town's most trusted business?

data.short_description: Unlike most repair sims that keep you locked in one shop, Between Jobs : Fixer Sim gives you a semi-open town to explore. Fix phones, laptops, and consoles under real pressure, then step outside. Taxi to the bar, the carnival, or wherever the night takes you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: i5 7th Gen / Ryzen 3 3000 series
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1650
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: i5 14th Gen / Ryzen 5 5000 series
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3050
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
